description:
List scanned websites by their AI-agent readiness (the Agent-Readiness directory).

A separate content family from news/CVE: each entry is a domain we actively scanned for
agent-facing surfaces across five categories (Discoverability / Content / Bot Access
Control / API-Auth-MCP-Skill / Commerce). Checks are graded like the Cloudflare
Agent-Ready scanner: each category yields a percentage, and the overall score (0-100,
Commerce excluded as informational) maps to Level 0-3 (0 Unprepared / 1 Agent-Curious /
2 Agent-Aware / 3 Agent-Native). Only scanned domains with results are listed.

Args:
    level: filter to a single readiness level (0-3)
    min_score: only surfaces with overall score (0-100) >= this value
    discovered_via: candidate source filter. e.g. "tranco" / "majestic" / "manual"
    sort: "score" (default, highest readiness first) or "recent" (recently changed first, for level-up tracking)
    limit: number of results (default 20, max 100)
    offset: paging start position

Returns:
    {total, count, limit, offset, items[]} — each item has domain, score (0-100), level,
    level_label, categories[] (per-category pct + pass/fail breakdown), checks[] (every
    check with its HTTP status), llms_txt_url, discovered_via and timestamps.
name: portal_list_agent_surfaces
